{{recipe}}

'''Musakhan''' is a Palestinian dish of spiced chicken flavored with sumac and served with bread.
==Ingredients==

* 200 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] raw [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]]
* 300 g chopped white [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* 100 g [[Cookbook:Sumac|sumac]]
* 100 g assorted raw [[Cookbook:Nut|nuts]]
* Black [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
* White pepper
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* 10 rolls of either Arabic village bread (markouk, or taboun or tannour) or spring roll pastry
==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] the chicken with the onion.
# Add the salt and the peppers before the chicken is done, and add the sumac 5 minutes from the end of cooking.
# Fry the raw nuts until they are golden. Add them to the chicken and onions
# Roll the mixture in the spring roll pastry, and [[Cookbook:Deep frying|deep fry]] them.
# Take the spring rolls out of the oil and let them dry on [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|cooking paper]]. 
# Serve them hot or cold.
